title: Inter at Atalanta: Lautaro on the bench? Thuram and Pio Esposito to start
caption:
Inter visit Atalanta on Sunday, and Lautaro Martínez could start on the bench: Thuram and Pio Esposito to start, per Corriere dello Sport (Nov 20, reported, not official). Atalanta are 12th under Maurizio Sarri, per Inter.it. We say Inter don't need Lautaro to start in Bergamo. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
